Terms of Sale

Last updated: 1 November 2026

1. Who we are

solid-sound.net is operated by Sølid Søund Studio, Cannes, France (details in the Legal Notice). Contact: {{email}} These terms apply to all purchases on this website.

2. Products and licence

We sell downloadable products (Ableton Live templates, presets, sample packs, music) and online studio services. Some products are created by independent creators and show the creator’s name; Solid Sound handles the sale, payment, delivery and customer support. Use of every product is governed by our License Agreement. You buy a licence to use the content, not ownership of it.

3. Prices and payment

Prices are set in euros (EUR) and may be shown in your local currency for convenience. The price at checkout, including any VAT that applies in your country, is the price you pay. Payment is taken when you place the order through our payment providers.

4. Delivery of digital products

Download links appear right after payment on the order page, in your account and in the confirmation email.

5. Right of withdrawal

Digital products: by placing the order you ask us to deliver the content immediately and confirm that you lose your 14-day right of withdrawal once the download is made available (Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code / Article 16(m) of Directive 2011/83/EU). You confirm this with a checkbox at checkout and we send the confirmation in your order email.

Studio services: you have 14 days from the order to withdraw. If you ask us to start within that period, you pay for the work done until you withdraw; once the service is fully delivered, the right of withdrawal ends.

To withdraw, send a clear statement to {{email}} with your order number. See also our Refund Policy.

6. Conformity

You benefit from the legal guarantee of conformity for digital content and services under EU and French law. If something does not work as described, contact us and we will repair, replace or refund.

7. Studio services

Scope, price, delivery time and number of revisions are shown on the service page or agreed in writing before work starts. You confirm that you own or have the right to use all material you send us. Delivery times are estimates. We keep your files confidential and use them only for your order.

8. Liability

We are responsible for foreseeable damage caused by our breach of these terms. We are not liable for damage caused by your software, hardware or third-party plugins. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

9. Personal data

See our Privacy Policy.

10. Law and disputes

These terms are governed by French law. If you are a consumer, you also keep the protection of the mandatory rules of your country of residence. Please contact us first – most issues are solved within a few days. EU consumers may also use free consumer mediation; details are available on request.

refund.text:
Refund Policy

Last updated: 1 November 2026

We want you to be happy with every purchase. This policy sits alongside our Terms of Sale. Nothing here limits your statutory rights as a consumer.

Digital products (templates, presets, sample packs, music)

EU consumers normally have 14 days to withdraw from an online purchase. For digital content, this right ends once the download is made available, because at checkout you expressly ask us to deliver it immediately and confirm that you lose the right of withdrawal. Without that confirmation we do not complete the order.

This does not affect your right to a working product. If a file is damaged, incomplete, does not match its description, or you did not receive it, contact us within 30 days and we will fix it, replace it or refund you.

Please check the requirements on the product page (DAW and version, third-party plugins) before you buy. Refunds are not available if a product works as described but your setup does not meet the listed requirements.

Studio services (mixing, mastering, production, sound design)
You can cancel within 14 days of ordering for a full refund if we have not started work.

How to ask

Email {{email}} with your order number and a short description. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 14 days.

Play at home
Play at the club/festival/party
Use in a live theatrical performance
Commercial Use of template-based productions

You can use template-based music for commercial purposes if you changed/modified all the main melodies. That’s our minimum requirement. You can keep drum samples, drum patterns, track structure, effects, synth presets, processing, etc.

If you changed all the main melodies then you can:

Use templates as a starting point for your own commercial productions
Release on a record label, iTunes, Spotify, YouTube, etc
Use for TV, web or radio advertisement
Use in videos, films, trailers, apps, games, or other multimedia
Use as part of a product available for purchase in a store or online

However, we recommend you to make deeper template modification (change synth presets, some drum samples, effects) if you’re going to release template-based track on a record label.

Re-sell or share the project (modified or not) or any samples/presets from the project
Claim exclusive ownership or authorship of the track without modifying original melodies
Use for creating sample libraries and royalty-free music

Can I render the template ‘as is’ and release it on a record label?

No, you can not. You should make significant changes into template. For example, change the root note, melody, sound processing, add your own ideas and sounds, etc. The main and minimum requirement is to change all the main melodies.

Are there any restrictions for using samples and presets from the template I purchased?

All samples and presets used in our products are royalty-free. You can use separate samples and presets in your own music productions. You are allowed to create the unlimited number of music productions based on one template. Any kind of separate distribution is strictly prohibited.

creator.text:
Solid Sound Creator Terms

Last updated: 14 October 2026

These terms apply to everyone who sells products (“Creators”) on solid-sound.net (“Solid Sound”, “we”). By applying to sell, you accept them together with our License and Privacy Policy.

1. What you can sell
DAW templates, presets, sample packs, MIDI, stems and music that you created or have the right to sell.
No third-party samples, loops or presets unless their licence allows redistribution. If in doubt, leave them out.
Every product needs a cover image, an MP3 preview and the correct details (format, genre, BPM, key and so on) so buyers can find it with our filters.
2. Approval
We review applications within 24 hours on business days.
New products are checked before they go live. We may ask you to fix details, or decline a product that breaks these terms.
3. Non-exclusive, your price
Selling here is non-exclusive. You may sell the same products anywhere else.
You set the price. Prices are stored in US dollars; buyers may see them converted into their local currency.
No listing or monthly fees.
4. Your share
Standard rate: 70% of the net sale price (after refunds, payment-provider fees and taxes such as VAT).
Founding Creators: the first 20 approved Creators receive 85% for 12 months from their approval date, then the standard rate.
We may change rates for future sales with 30 days’ notice by email. Rates for sales already made never change.
5. Payouts
Payouts are made once a month, when your available balance is at least $25. A smaller balance rolls over to the next month.
Earnings from an order become available after the refund period has passed.
We pay by PayPal or bank transfer. Fees charged by these providers may be deducted.
You are responsible for your own taxes on your earnings.
6. Licence to us and to buyers
You keep the copyright in your products.
You give Solid Sound a non-exclusive licence to host, preview, promote (including on our social media, with your name) and sell your products.
Buyers receive a royalty-free licence to use the product in their own music, as described on our License page. They may not resell or share the files themselves.
7. Refunds and disputes
Refunds follow our store refund policy. Refunded sales are removed from your balance.
If a product is reported for copyright infringement, we may remove it while we investigate.
8. Creator perks
Approved Creators get 20% off our mixing and mastering services.
9. Ending
You may stop selling at any time by removing your products or contacting us. Your remaining balance above the payout minimum will be paid out.
We may suspend or close a Creator account that breaks these terms. Buyers who already purchased keep access to their downloads.
10. Contact

Questions about these terms: contact us.
